description: Per-stock limit-up attribution based only on published views and research. Returns leading_concept, concept_tags, nullable reason, attribution_status, empty_reason, evidence_refs and last_attempt_at. Incremental updates depend on service configuration; scheduled generation also maintains processing status. pending, processing, no_verified_catalyst, failed, budget_deferred and legacy_unknown are distinct. Inherited reasons retain their original generation time. Omit trade_date for the latest stored day; pass today explicitly for today's coverage. Optional as_of reads saved versions available at a historical instant without using later evidence.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

as_of.description: Historical cutoff with timezone, no later than now; saved versions only

trade_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; omit for the latest *attributed* day (falls back to the previous day until today's first slot lands ~09:47 Beijing — pass today explicitly for today's data)

name: limit_up_analysis
